name: @pipeworx/mcp-inxight-drugs

tools.name: inxight_substance
tools.description: Drug development status by indication from NCATS Inxight Drugs: for one drug or substance (by name or FDA UNII), every condition it is approved for or in clinical trials for with the highest phase reached per condition (Approved, Phase III, Phase II, Phase I) and the trial or label behind it, plus the overall highest development event, first approval year and source, originator company, molecular targets with pharmacology and potency, synonyms, and cross-reference ids (ChEMBL, DrugBank, PubChem, CAS, MeSH, RxCUI). Answers "what is psilocybin being developed for and how far along", "which indications is this drug approved for", "is this compound still in trials".

name.description: Drug or substance name, brand or generic (e.g. "psilocybin", "aspirin", "semaglutide"). Give name or unii.

unii.description: FDA Unique Ingredient Identifier, 10 characters (e.g. "2RV7212BP0" for psilocybin). Takes precedence over name.

tools.name: inxight_search
tools.description: Search NCATS Inxight Drugs substances by free text (drug name, synonym, code, company or condition words), optionally narrowed to a development status (US Approved Rx, US Approved OTC, US Previously Marketed, Possibly Marketed Outside US, Clinical, Other). Returns matching substances with FDA UNII and class, the total hit count, and breakdowns of the matches by development status, highest phase and top conditions. Use it to find the UNII to pass to inxight_substance or to scan, e.g., which psychedelics are in clinical development.

development_status.description: Only substances whose overall development status is this value

tools.name: inxight_indication
tools.description: Drugs and substances approved for or in clinical development for a condition, from NCATS Inxight Drugs: give a disease or indication (e.g. "stroke", "major depressive disorder", "migraine") and get each substance with the highest phase it has reached FOR THAT CONDITION, the trial or label URL behind it, and its FDA UNII. Narrow with development_status "Clinical" to see only investigational drugs. Also returns the related condition labels Inxight uses (e.g. "Ischemic stroke", "Acute ischemic stroke") so a caller can drill down.

development_status.description: Only substances whose overall development status is this value; "Clinical" = investigational only

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-inxight-drugs forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the inxight-drugs pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
